# orchestration_cluster_role (Resource)

A role inside a Camunda cluster. See the Camunda documentation on [roles](https://docs.camunda.io/docs/components/admin/role/).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orchestration_cluster_role" "example" {
  role_id     = "my-role"
  name        = "My Role"
  description = "A role managed by Terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the role.
- `role_id` (String) The unique ID for the role.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the role. Omit this attribute (or set it to `null`) to indicate no description — the API cannot distinguish an empty string from an absent description, so an explicitly configured empty string is rejected rather than silently normalized to null.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the role (the role ID).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orchestration_cluster_role.example "my-role"
```
